proof_summary: The central device is the determinant-like error \(D_n=L_{n-1}^2-L_nL_{n-2}\): for the candidate linear-recurrence solution, growth estimates \(L_{n+1}\ge 3L_n>0\) and the relation \(D_{m+5}=4D_{m+3}+D_{m+2}\) give \(1\le D_n\le L_{n-2}\) by induction. Hence \(L_{n+1}^2=L_{n+2}L_n+D_{n+2}\) lies in the precise interval forcing \(\lceil L_{n+1}^2/L_n\rceil-1=L_{n+2}\), so induction identifies the extremally defined sequence with the linear-recurrence solution.
